scope: First-pass primary-source comparison; no adoption or hardware claim.
confirmed_deviations: PMP10948 is two interleaved transition-mode UCC28063 stages (750 W + 550 W classes); local deck is one boost leg with a host-authored UCC28180_FN surrogate and CCM-style current loop.
PMP10948 uses separate VBULK and B+ outputs; local deck has VD/VB model split joined by an ideal closed F2 and a single RLOAD.
Local deck uses generic STWMOS/DBOOST/DBODY and ideal probes; PMP BOM identifies 600 V Infineon MOSFETs, MUR860G diodes, and 160 uH inductors.
Local deck prescribes 15 V auxiliary, 5 V logic, permit/arm/standby PWL sequencing; this is not demonstrated to match either TI reference startup/bias network.
not_yet_compared: Exact compensation component values and slope/ramp implementation against PMP10948 schematic or TIDA-00779 schematic.
Current-sense scaling, gate-driver delay, startup/bias circuitry, and protection thresholds against TI schematics.
Magnetic core/saturation, thermal, EMI, surge/EFT, and dynamic induction-load behavior.
conditional_scaling_gap: At 120 VAC and 1.8 kW DC output, even 95.6% efficiency/PF near 0.999 implies about 1.88 kW input and 15.7 A RMS, above the local 15 A screen. This is a conditional arithmetic incompatibility, not a hardware rating.
conclusion: Use PMP10948 for interleaving/high-power measurement context, UCC28180EVM-573 for controller-scale behavior, and TIDA-00779 for same-controller high-power CCM context. Do not import any reference as a validated local model without schematic/component/operating-range correlation.
